time_policy.availability: scheduled departure UTC + signed departure delay + actual elapsed time
time_policy.limitation: Arrival-event assumption; actual publication/ingestion availability is not observed.
time_policy.window: target-N*24h <= source scheduled departure < target; arrival < target
time_policy.uncertain_time: exclude source; retain target with empty histories
time_policy.test_history: causal rolling outcomes, after frozen selection only
